name: Training Machine Learning Models
description: This skill trains machine learning models using automated workflows. It analyzes datasets, selects appropriate model types (classification, regression, etc.), configures training parameters, trains the model with cross-validation, generates performance metrics, and saves the trained model artifact. Use this skill when the user requests to "train" a model, needs to evaluate a dataset for machine learning purposes, or wants to optimize model performance. The skill supports common frameworks like scikit-learn.
